messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Of course, Saturday was a complete no-no as my back had completely seized up.

output.original_text: Of course, Saturday was a complete no-no as my back had completely seized up.
output.joy: Of course, Saturday had to be marked as a no-no since my back was so stiff and cranky!
output.sadness: Of course, Saturday turned into a no-no as my back completely seized up, leaving me feeling so helpless.
output.fear: Of course, Saturday was a definite no-no; my back completely seized up, and I couldn't shake the worry of it getting worse.
output.anger: Of course, Saturday was a complete no-no! My back seized up, and I was so furious about being limited like this.
output.surprise: Of course, Saturday was a no-no, but I was shocked when my back completely seized up out of nowhere!
output.disgust: Of course, Saturday was a complete no-no; I was disgusted that my back had seized up just like that.
